妮娜的生活方式(Nina's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:妮娜的经历、感受与成长。

Nina prefers rainy weather when running in the library. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. On Tuesday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. For example, a second-hand shop sells worn boots.

At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. The subway station has become an important part of daily life. There are always more possibilities than we expect. What's more, a big crowd waited at the gate.
Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Follow the map and you won't get lost.
The riverside walk looked quieter than usual that evening. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Little by little, things began to change. A telegram arrived saying that Aunt Rose was safe.
Nina has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. People around Nina often share different ideas about the riverside walk. Amy advised Nina to try singing as a new hobby.
